completeness.why: All five provider functions are reduced to mapping their own fields into linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the whole sequence (upgrade with not-found throw or insert plus transfer payee, initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event); each preserved inconsistency is an explicit argument (mask/officialName for GoCardless, fileId only from Pluggy.ai, syncEventTables ['transactions'] for Akahu), and the bank key stays chosen per provider via bankId.

interface.why: Parameters map one-to-one onto the real variations (sync source, account id, name, official name, optional mask, institution and bank key, optional fileId, sync-event tables), with no speculative options, and the preserved inconsistencies are visible at each call site as explicit arguments.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed and replaced by thin wrappers that only pass provider data; no part of the sequence remains reshaped at a site.
